description:
Client: HealthEdge
 Location: Powell, OH and Burlington, MA (Burlington, MA opening more urgent) 
 Interview Process: Phone Interview -> On-Site or Skype Interview -> Hire
 Notes:
 Candidates must be able to pass a background check and drug test
 Description:
 Our client is looking a Java/Oracle Integration Engineer to working on software product implementation and integration projects for extenal client customers. Candidate will be responsible for all hands-on technical/development work while also communication directly with the end customer to help gather/understand requirements and to provide status updates. 
 This position will require up to 25% travel to customer sites. 
 Must haves: 
 Strong Core Java development experience 
 Experience working on integration and impletation projects for a software product for an external customer. This experience must include making modifications of the software product to meet customer requirements and performing all of the hands-on technical integration development. 
 Strong Oracle database and SQL scripting experience 
 Experience with XML or a similar technology for integration projects 
 Experience with a source control tool (such as Git, SVN, etc) 
 Linux experience 
 

 Java with Oracle Integration Experience

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
